description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProductListFragment class for an Android app. The fragment displays a scrollable list of products, includes a personalized greeting, search filtering, and quick filter chips for product categories like Organic, Discounts, and Popular. It manages RecyclerView setup, user interactions such as item clicks leading to a ProductDetailActivity, and observable data via ViewModel.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Product items, handling view creation, data binding, and user interaction.

classes.name: ProductViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ViewHolder that binds Product data to views and handles item click events.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView and search/filter logic, observes ViewModel data, and triggers product loading.

methods.name: setupQuickFilters
methods.description: Creates filter chips dynamically for quick filtering of products based on categories.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of products.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder instance for a product item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds product data to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the data set.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product object to the ViewHolder's views.
